== Course of events ==

After Jack Pumpkinhead and the Saw-Horse arrived at the green wall of the Emerald City, the Scarecrow, believing the two spoke different languages, called for an interpreter. Jack Pumpkinhead admits that his assumption was mistaken, acknowledging that no interpreter was in fact needed for him to be understood.

This admission clears the way for Jack Pumpkinhead to be received directly, leading to his meeting with His Majesty the Scarecrow, ruler of the Emerald City. Despite Jack's correction, Jellia Jamb is nonetheless brought in to translate between the two, an arrangement that results in Jellia mischievously mistranslating their words so that each appears to insult the other.
